full_name: Ann Jones | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2010–2011 Journalism & Nonfiction Mildred Londa Weisman Fellow Independent Writer
bio: Ann Jones, writer and photographer, wrote extensively about violence against women in the United States before turning to the situation of women exposed to both private and publicly condoned violence in war-torn countries.
